mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 64 degrees. If you are a space fan, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 6:30 PM, rising from the direction of Belleville and traveling toward the Fitchburg and Madison area, climbing to about halfway up the sky for two minutes.

In city news, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is progressing. Construction crews are currently focused on wrapping up concrete curbs, sidewalks, and driveways, with work planned to continue as weather permits. Residents should note that the surface layer of asphalt is expected to be installed next spring.

There is plenty happening in Verona to keep you busy. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza with a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at the intersection for some time. The individual was taken into custody and arrested for an O W I.

Today's featured flavor at Culver's is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open for business and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
